from pyspark.sql.functions import col, from_json,lit,  concat
from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, StringType
from datetime import datetime
#### Recupero ultimo codice oggetto disponibile per ogni notifica analogica presente su pn_timeline

spark.sql(
"""with multiple_codes as (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        get_json_object(details,'$.sendRequestId') as chiave,
        get_json_object(details, '$.registeredLetterCode') as registeredLetterCode,
        timelineelementid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY get_json_object(details,'$.sendRequestId') ORDER BY ingestion_tms DESC) as rowno
    FROM fat_delta.pn_timeline
    WHERE get_json_object(details, '$.deliveryDetailCode') = "CON080"
    AND category in ("SEND_ANALOG_PROGRESS","SEND_SIMPLE_REGISTERED_LETTER_PROGRESS")
    AND get_json_object(details, '$.registeredLetterCode') is not null)
SELECT chiave, timelineelementid, registeredLetterCode
FROM multiple_codes
WHERE rowno = 1
""").createOrReplaceTempView("tmpRegisteredLetterCodeNew")
last_modified = datetime.now()
#### Join con notifiche perfezionate per recuperare campi utili

spark.sql(f"""SELECT DISTINCT
            n.event_id
            ,p.timelineelementid
            ,n.iun
            ,n.recipients.recipientid[0] as recId
            ,n.year
            ,n.month
            ,n.daily
            ,p.registeredLetterCode
            ,'{last_modified}' as LastModified
        FROM fat_delta.notifiche n
        LEFT JOIN tmpRegisteredLetterCodeNew p ON n.event_id = p.chiave
        WHERE n.notificationtype <> 'Digitale' AND p.registeredLetterCode IS NOT NULL""").createOrReplaceTempView("dfNotifiche")
#### Upsert fat_delta.notifiche_codoggetto

spark.sql("""
MERGE INTO fat_delta.notifiche_codoggetto AS target
USING dfNotifiche AS source
ON target.event_id = source.event_id
WHEN MATCHED AND target.registeredLetterCode <> source.registeredLetterCode THEN
  UPDATE SET target.registeredLetterCode = source.registeredLetterCode,
             target.LastModified = source.LastModified
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
  INSERT (event_id,timelineelementid,iun,recId, year, month, daily,registeredLetterCode,LastModified)
  VALUES (source.event_id,source.timelineelementid,source.iun,source.recId,source.year,source.month,source.daily,source.registeredLetterCode,source.LastModified)
#### Selezione righe aggiornate o inserite per import su SQL
dfNotifiche_modificate = spark.sql(f"select * from fat_delta.notifiche_codoggetto where LastModified = '{last_modified}'")
dfCodOggettoDL_filtered = dfNotifiche_modificate.withColumn("eventId",concat(col("event_id"),lit('.'),col('recId')))\
.select("eventId", "iun", "year", "month", "registeredLetterCode")

# get the function to retrieve sql properties
%run Utility/getSQLConnectionString

# retrieve sql connection_string and connection_properties
jdbcUrl,conn_Prop = getSQLConnectionString()

dfToSql = dfCodOggettoDL_filtered.withColumnRenamed("eventid","event_id")\
                    .withColumnRenamed("iun","iun")\
                    .withColumnRenamed("year","year")\
                    .withColumnRenamed("month","month")\
                    .withColumnRenamed("registeredLetterCode","CodiceOggetto")
if (dfToSql.count() > 0):
dfToSql.write.jdbc(url=jdbcUrl, table="stg.Notifiche_CodiceOggetto", mode = 'overwrite', properties=conn_Prop)
